paper.title_en: Unconventional magnetic field response of X-ray magnetic circular dichroism in $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$
paper.abstract_en: Altermagnets are compensated collinear magnets that break time-reversal symmetry without net magnetization, enabling unconventional magneto-optical responses. Here, we experimentally demonstrate X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) in hematite $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ for X-rays incident along the [111] direction, perpendicular to the applied magnetic field and the weak ferromagnetic moment induced by the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. The XMCD amplitude reaches approximately 10 \% of the polarization-averaged X-ray absorption intensity, whereas it is nearly suppressed for $\mathbf{H}\parallel[1\bar{1}0]$ of 200 mT. This unique behavior is consistent with field-driven changes between configurations associated with different magnetic symmetries. Our results establish that XMCD in the altermagnet $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ exhibits a fundamentally distinct response compared to that of weak ferromagnetism. This study addresses how XMCD in altermagnets responds to external magnetic fields compared to conventional ferromagnets.
